articles.title: Strategy raises $2 billion through MSTR sales and creates new USD Cash pool
articles.snippet: The company sold 18.26 million MSTR shares, increased its USD Reserve to $5.1 billion and repurchased another $136.4 million of STRC.

articles.title: Pakistan kicks off crypto licensing regime with Sept. 5 registration deadline
articles.snippet: PVARA said companies have until the deadline to submit their application for a no-objection certificate or otherwise cease operating.

articles.title: Strive buys 1,110 Bitcoin for $81.5M, holdings top 21K BTC; ASST shares surge 11%
articles.snippet: Strive’s Nasdaq-traded shares surged more than 11% as the Bitcoin treasury company said it paid an average of $73,409 per BTC, pushing its holdings to 21,356 Bitcoin.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI leads $68M Fasset round at $1B valuation
articles.snippet: Fasset raised $68 million in a Series C led by SBI Group as the companies plan a digital bank in Malaysia and to expand stablecoin payments.

articles.title: Bitcoin rally sends crypto stocks soaring as miners, treasury companies jump
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s rally above $79,000 lifted miners and treasury companies, with Canaan, Strive and Metaplanet posting double-digit gains as crypto stocks surged.
